report:
Decision: ADMIT (guard changed, not the skill's promise). The dev-plan gate already carries the identical precedent for the identical prior defect (guard-devplan-policy.mjs DEFAULT_EXEMPT_PREFIXES, backlog 2026-08-08): scratch/ is exempt from that gate's phase check because a consumer following shipped guidance was refused by a guard the guidance never cleared. The lifecycle-ready guard's readiness check (GUARD-LIFECYCLE-NOT-READY) had no such exemption, so the same shape of contradiction recurred for the onboarding-readiness sub-check inside the same hook file. Scoped narrowly to the two intake statuses named in the Goal (intake-required, intake-design-questions-required) -- not a general readiness bypass.

Changes (commit 94bfe0bea2ac9fface9df7eb09c15b13c0965f25, plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs / .test.mjs / skills/pipeline-start/SKILL.md):
- Added INTAKE_LIFECYCLE_STATUSES (Set of the two intake statuses).
- Added isIntakeLifecycleScratchWrite(input, root): admits any Edit/Write/NotebookEdit whose writeTargetPath() resolves, via resolve()+pathInside() (never substring/prefix-string), strictly inside <root>/scratch. Bare scratch/ itself as a target does not qualify.
- Added isIntakeLifecycleScratchMkdir(command, root): admits `mkdir scratch`/`mkdir -p scratch`/`mkdir -p scratch/<nested>` via the same resolve()+pathInside() comparison.
- Wired both into evaluateAfterGrammarAdmission()'s catch block, gated on error.lifecycleStatus being a member of INTAKE_LIFECYCLE_STATUSES -- mirrors the existing `partial`-status diagnosis lane's shape exactly.
- Extended blocked()'s guidance text: a refusal during either intake status now names the admitted scratch/ lane, mirroring the discoverability fix NVA-LCREADONLY-2 already made for the partial lane.
- SKILL.md 'Scratch space' section: added one clarifying sentence naming that GUARD-LIFECYCLE-NOT-READY itself (not just containment and dev-plan) now admits scratch/ during the two intake statuses.

Tests: node --test plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-lifecycle-ready.test.mjs -> 161/161 pass (evidence: this dispatch's own terminal output, exit code 0). New test 'NVA-GF-SCRATCH: intake statuses admit any resolved scratch/ write and matching mkdir, nothing wider' covers: nested Edit/Write/NotebookEdit writes and both mkdir shapes admitted for both intake statuses; a sibling directory merely starting with "scratch", a lexical `../` escape, the bare scratch/ directory itself, and ordinary non-scratch paths still refused with GUARD-LIFECYCLE-NOT-READY; the refusal for a non-scratch write names the new lane; restart-required and partial (unaffected pre-existing statuses) still refuse the identical nested-scratch shape this new lane admits elsewhere.
